semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GLIT is a consortium of manufacturing companies that provides end-to-end solutions relevant to semiconductor manufacturing equipment and other high-tech applications.
summary: GLIT, or Guild for Leading Innovative Technology, is a consortium of 14 small and medium-sized enterprises in Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, offering comprehensive manufacturing solutions. Their technology is utilized in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and various other industries, providing a one-stop solution from component procurement to assembly.

regional_presence.Japan: GLIT is primarily based in Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, focusing on high-tech manufacturing solutions.
